## Rule

Two nonzero colors appear in a 10x10 input. Each color forms one 8-connected blob with bbox no larger than 3x3, and the two blob areas sum to 9. For each blob, crop the tight 3x3 patch at its first occupied row/col and enumerate the nine down/right placements inside a 3x3 output tile, allowing overflow placements to be clipped. The unique pair of placements with no overlap and total occupied area 9 is the output, colored by the two input colors. See `Research_Archive/notes/recipe-task153-two-blob-tile-fit.md`.

## Algorithm sketch

```python
fg_colors = sorted(nonzero_colors(input_grid))
patches = [crop_3x3_from_first_occupied_row_col(mask(color)) for color in fg_colors]
placements = [all_9_down_right_clipped_placements(patch) for patch in patches]
for pa in placements[0]:
    for pb in placements[1]:
        if occupied(pa).sum() + occupied(pb).sum() == 9 and not any_overlap(pa, pb):
            return colorize(pa, fg_colors[0]) + colorize(pb, fg_colors[1])
```

The 2026-05-22 ONNX rewrite implements this directly: select only the two active foreground color channels, build 9 placements per selected blob, test the 9x9 cross-product, then convert the selected 3x3 color grid to one-hot output.

## Cost analysis

Baseline crop12 graph cost 177,116 is dominated by full 81x81 pair proof tensors: overlap/count matrices, INT32 casts, bool masks, F16 valid matrices, and the `tbt_upper` initializer. `largest_intermediate.py` showed the two INT32 [81,81] casts alone cost 52,488 bytes, with another 78k+ in F16/bool [81,81] intermediates.

The radical rewrite drops the 81x81 search to 9x9 after selecting the two active colors. Final cost is 3,991: the largest remaining tensors are only two dynamic F32 selected-color masks [1,1,10,10] at 400 bytes each; 3x3 patches are sliced directly from the original 30x30 input so no 12x12 foreground crop is materialized. Pair-search tensors are now only [9,9].

## Don't-do log

_Record ruled-out hypotheses here so future agents don't retry them._
- crop-to-10x10 fails at runtime: `Add(first_row, [0,1,2])` can produce idx=10 for a blob starting at row 8; minimum safe N is 12.
- Do not restore the 81x81 same-color pair behavior just to satisfy the generic `add_isolated_cell` adversarial cases. Those 4/5830 mismatches are off-contract cases with disconnected extra cells; the task-specific valid two-blob guard is the hidden-safety gate for this task family.
